content.short: HashEx is a blockchain security and auditing company.
content.description: HashEx delivers cybersecurity support for teams launching new DeFi projects. The offering spans DeFi security, development tools, and career services to advance Web3. Since its inception, HashEx has audited more than 1,200 smart contracts across projects of varying sizes, producing thorough reports that identify potential threats and code vulnerabilities and outlining practical steps to remediate them. To date, these efforts have helped clients save more than $3.4 billion in investor funds.
